# Nyuchi Docs

> Engineering and product documentation for the Nyuchi platform — how things
> are done at Nyuchi, the product guide for platform.nyuchi.com, and how to use
> the Mzizi tools. Nyuchi Africa is a Zimbabwean frontier-infrastructure company
> inside the Bundu Foundation ecosystem. Long-form product docs for the wider
> ecosystem live at docs.bundu.org; this site is the engineering / how-to surface.

## Platform

- [Quickstart](https://docs.nyuchi.com/platform/quickstart): Get started on the Nyuchi platform.
- [Key concepts](https://docs.nyuchi.com/platform/key-concepts): The core model behind the platform.
- [Product workspaces](https://docs.nyuchi.com/platform/product-workspaces): How product surfaces are organised.
- [Configuration](https://docs.nyuchi.com/platform/configuration/settings): Settings, sign-in, user management.
- [Administration](https://docs.nyuchi.com/platform/administration/roles-permissions): Roles, permissions, audit logs.

## API Docs

- [API overview](https://docs.nyuchi.com/api/overview): The versioned /v1 gateway and product namespaces.
- [Authentication](https://docs.nyuchi.com/api/authentication): WorkOS AuthKit sign-in and the platform JWT.
- [API keys](https://docs.nyuchi.com/api/api-keys): Console-managed client ID and secret pairings.
- [Security](https://docs.nyuchi.com/api/security): Security and rate limits.
- [Namespaces](https://docs.nyuchi.com/api/commerce): Commerce, Pay, Logistics, Lingo, News, Weather.

## Analytics

- [Quickstart](https://docs.nyuchi.com/analytics/quickstart): Connect data and get started.
- [Dashboards](https://docs.nyuchi.com/analytics/dashboards/create-dashboard): Build dashboards, charts, sharing/exports.
- [Reports](https://docs.nyuchi.com/analytics/reports/build-report): Build and schedule reports.

## Integrations

- [Quickstart](https://docs.nyuchi.com/integrations/quickstart): Authentication and integration basics.
- [Connectors](https://docs.nyuchi.com/integrations/connectors/crm): CRM, data warehouse, messaging.
- [Webhooks & events](https://docs.nyuchi.com/integrations/webhooks/configure): Configure, event types, retry policies.

## Products

- [Mukoko Kweli](https://docs.nyuchi.com/kweli/overview): The Africa Trust Platform — places, organizations, and verification.
- [Mukoko Weather](https://docs.nyuchi.com/mukoko-weather/user-guide): Weather intelligence user guide and station network.

## Identity & Console

- [Identity](https://docs.nyuchi.com/identity/overview): Authentication and identity across the platform.
- [Console](https://docs.nyuchi.com/console/overview): The Nyuchi Console (platform.nyuchi.com).

## Tools

- [Tools directory](https://docs.nyuchi.com/tools): Every agent skill, CLI, and MCP server across the Nyuchi and Bundu repos — what it is, which repo owns it, how to install it.

## Mzizi Tools

- [Overview](https://docs.nyuchi.com/mzizi-tools/overview): The Mzizi consumer tooling — mzizi-mcp, mzizi-cli (the fundi agent), mzizi-skills, auth-by-audience, and the skills authoring flow. The Mzizi design system itself lives at mzizi.dev.
- [The DNA double helix](https://docs.nyuchi.com/mzizi-tools/dna-helix): The architecture Mzizi serves — nodes on an engineering and a meaning backbone, held by cross-cutting rungs (fundi, documentation, discovery). No axes, no outliers, no 3D. Node numbers are labels, not a sequence, and the node set is never capped.
- [Registry health](https://docs.nyuchi.com/mzizi-tools/registry-health): What the 64 Mzizi registry MCP tools actually return — which are broken, which serve retired data, which to trust.
- [A2A](https://docs.nyuchi.com/mzizi-tools/a2a): Design (not yet shipped) for mzizi-mcp delegating long-running security, chaos, and accessibility runs to the fundi agent as A2A tasks rather than blocking MCP tool calls.

## Deployment & Conventions

- [Deployment](https://docs.nyuchi.com/deployment/overview): How Nyuchi surfaces are deployed.
- [Conventions](https://docs.nyuchi.com/conventions/overview): Engineering conventions and doctrine.
